name: NVDebug Diagnostic Agent
description: HTTP bridge from OpenClaw to NVIDIA diagnostic-agent for nvdebug hardware fault triage.

baseUrl.description: Diagnostic-agent service base URL. Defaults to http://diagnostic-agent.

apiKey.description: Optional diagnostic-agent API key. Defaults to DIAGNOSTIC_AGENT_API_KEY from the OpenClaw pod environment.

subagentEventsUrl.description: Optional Mosaic UI endpoint that receives live diagnostic subagent events.

enabledTools.description: Optional allowlist of diagnostic OpenClaw tool names to register.

disabledTools.description: Optional list of diagnostic OpenClaw tool names to suppress.

timeoutMs.label: Tool-call timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.help: nvdebug collections can take several minutes; 1800000 gives the full diagnostic path room to finish.

subagentEventsUrl.label: Subagent events URL
subagentEventsUrl.help: Mosaic UI endpoint for rendering nvdebug as a read-only subagent panel.
